correctness.rationale: The curvature measure hinge representation proves the exact finite n norm by Minkowski. Singular support of the second distributional derivatives shows equality rigidity. A bounded second-moment Gaussian triangular-array CLT plus an integrable uniform kernel envelope proves all interior asymptotics; the explicit three-region bound rules out boundary maximizing sequences. Integration by parts yields the leading constant, and compactness forces midpoint localization. Standalone assertions independently corroborate formulas but are not used as infinite proof.
